Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 140. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 30 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Explosive Wave
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (45 foot radius)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
Send a massive explosion of energy out in all
directions from you. All creatures within range must
make a dexterity saving throw or take 4d12 Fire
damage, half on a success.
